text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco says privatisation of Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE) is completed and the government will not cancel the sale as requested by one of the unsuccessful bidders for BFE, Banco Finantia.
- Glass company Barbosa & Almeida is to invest 525 million escudos to establish two glass companies in Mozambique, the northern Portuguese company said yesterday.
- Mobile phones sales in the nine months to September rose 91 percent when compared to the same period in 1995.
- One third of Portugal's territory is threatened by desertification and the government has decided to ask for financial help from Brussels.
